summary: TransAlta Corporation filed a Form 6-K attaching a press release declaring regular quarterly dividends on its common and preferred shares. The common dividend is $0.07 per share payable Oct. 1, 2026, to holders of record Sept. 1, 2026. Preferred dividends are declared for Series A through G with rates ranging from 4.353% to 6.894% and specified record and payment dates in Sept. 2026. This is a routine dividend announcement with no special-situation event (e.g., acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or management change). The filing is a foreign private issuer's routine current report on Form 6-K. No deal terms apply.
